historical_field_loss.first_observed_loss_point: The first persisted Mission 041B decoded provider row in post_heal_output.json contains only input.url; the original response body is not retained.

verified_aeigs_defect.historical_impact: The original Mission 041B response bytes and a raw-to-derived lineage record were not retained, preventing a conclusive provider-versus-AEGIS attribution after the fact.
verified_aeigs_defect.fix: OneShotRerunResult now retains response bytes in memory, computes a safe SHA-256, and can preserve those bytes once to an explicit non-overwriting evidence path. Future reruns also emit decoded-provider-to-derived-AEGIS field lineage.

next_step: Use the already authorized read-only dashboard access to open Quick View for the uniquely correlated run if the browser bridge becomes available. Do not run a new collection. If the historical output cannot be retrieved before retention expires, require a new explicit authorization for one bounded rerun using the revised evidence-preserving transport.
